'''Donald John Trump''' (born June 14, 1946) is an American businessman, media personality, and politician who served as the 45th president of the United States from 2017 to 2021 and 47th president from 2024 to present.

=== Conspiracies ===
Trump has frequently been associated with conspiracy theories, both as a subject and a proponent. A notable example is the "birther" conspiracy, which falsely claimed that President Barack Obama was not born in the United States, a narrative Trump promoted before and during his 2016 presidential campaign. During his presidency, Trump faced allegations of spreading misinformation regarding the COVID-19 pandemic, the legitimacy of the 2020 presidential election, and various policies. His administration was marked by frequent controversies, including investigations into Russian interference in the 2016 election, which led to the Special Counsel investigation by Robert Mueller which documented extensive Russian interference and led to numerous convictions of Trump associates on various charges.

Trump's connection to Alex Jones further fueled controversy. Jones endorsed Trump during the 2016 election. Trump appeared on Jones's show in December 2015, praising him for his reputation. 

== Knowledge Fight Coverage ==
[http://Category:2015%20Investigation Knowledge Fight's 2015 Investigation Series] chronicles Alex Jones' shift in stance on Donald Trump. Initially, Jones criticized Trump as a casino-owning mobster and poser who was a joke candidate who could potentially throw the election for Clinton. Over the course of 2015, influenced partly by Roger Stone and Russian connections, his perspective morphed into full-out support. In one episode, Jones claims he was scheduled to meet with RT but was instead interrogated by Russian intelligence upon arrival.
